import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

plt.rcParams['font.size'] = 12

# Load data

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(constrained_layout=True, figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3)

# Subplot 1: Survival by passenger class and sex
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
survival_by_class_sex = df.groupby(['pclass', 'sex', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
survival_by_class_sex_percent = survival_by_class_sex.div(survival_by_class_sex.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100

x = np.arange(len(survival_by_class_sex_percent.index))
width = 0.35
bars1 = ax1.bar(x - width/2, survival_by_class_sex_percent[1], width, 
                label='Survived', color='#2ecc71', edgecolor='black')
bars2 = ax1.bar(x + width/2, survival_by_class_sex_percent[0], width, 
                label='Did not survive', color='#e74c3c', edgecolor='black')

ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class & Sex', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Sex', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xticks(x)
ax1.set_xticklabels([f'Class {pclass}\n{sex}' for (pclass, sex) in survival_by_class_sex_percent.index])
ax1.legend()
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Add value labels on bars
for bars in [bars1, bars2]:
    for bar in bars:
        height = bar.get_height()
        ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.5,
                f'{height:.1f}%', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# Subplot 2: Age distribution by survival
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
survived_age = df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna()
not_survived_age = df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna()

ax2.hist([survived_age, not_survived_age], bins=20, 
         label=['Survived', 'Did not survive'], 
         color=['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Count', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend()
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Subplot 3: Survival by embarkation port
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
embark_survival = df.groupby(['embark_town', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
embark_survival_percent = embark_survival.div(embark_survival.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100

x_embark = np.arange(len(embark_survival_percent))
bars3 = ax3.bar(x_embark - 0.2, embark_survival_percent[1], 0.4, 
                color='#2ecc71', edgecolor='black', label='Survived')
bars4 = ax3.bar(x_embark + 0.2, embark_survival_percent[0], 0.4, 
                color='#e74c3c', edgecolor='black', label='Did not survive')

ax3.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port', fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)', fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Port', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xticks(x_embark)
ax3.set_xticklabels(embark_survival_percent.index)
ax3.legend()
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Subplot 4: Fare distribution by passenger class
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
fare_data = [df[df['pclass'] == i]['fare'].dropna() for i in range(1, 4)]

    patch.set_alpha(0.7)

ax4.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare (currency units)', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Passenger Class', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Subplot 5: Family size impact on survival
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch'] + 1
family_survival = df.groupby(['family_size', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
family_survival_percent = family_survival.div(family_survival.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100

family_sizes = family_survival_percent.index[:8]  # Limit to first 8 family sizes
x_family = np.arange(len(family_sizes))
bars5 = ax5.bar(x_family - 0.2, family_survival_percent.loc[family_sizes, 1], 0.4, 
                color='#2ecc71', edgecolor='black', label='Survived')
bars6 = ax5.bar(x_family + 0.2, family_survival_percent.loc[family_sizes, 0], 0.4,

ax6.legend(title='Passenger Class')
